text:
Jules: Anyone up for a dumpling hop + silent karaoke next Friday? thinking 6:30 start, 2–3 spots for dumplings then a quiet room for karaoke (headphones). :dumpling: :microphone:
Maria: totally in. can we do earlier? 6:00 would be better for me.
Dan: Count me in too. FYI i'm bringing trivia questions if we get a table. :nerd_face: 
Olivia: I can call the first dumpling place — which neighborhood? downtown or mission?
Jules: leaning downtown so we can walk between places. 6:00 works — let's set a poll?
Sam: vegetarian options? i can't do pork.
Sanjay: veg ok — there are at least two spots on the route with veggie dumplings.
Olivia: booked a provisional table at "Bao & Co." for 6:05 for 6 ppl (2 hours) — they'll hold for 15 min. I left a note asking about veggie plank.
Jules: awesome, thanks Olivia. shall we do karaoke after around 8:15? i found "Silent Sing" on 4th, private rooms with headphone mic.
Maria: 8:15 works. also i'm bringing a portable speaker for the walk playlist. :)
Dan: can someone add this to the calendar invite? 
Olivia: i'll create the calendar event now and add timezone-friendly times. link: https://calendar.example/evt/abc123
Sam: RSVP yes. allergic to shellfish so pls avoid spots with cross-contamination if possible.
Sanjay: noted. Olivia — maybe ask Bao if they have separate prep for veg/shellfish?
Olivia: will ask. also what should we do about rides? meet at lobby 5:45 and carpool?
Jules: lobby meet sounds good. @CafeBot can you create a quick poll for rides and short list?
CafeBot: Poll created: "How are you getting there?" Options: Walk / Carpool (I can drive) / Uber. Link: https://polls.cafebot/p/xyz
Maria: carpool if someone can pick me up near 7th & Pine.
Dan: I can drive, 3 seats.
Sam: Uber for me, thanks.
Jules: perfect. last thing — budget cap around $25 per person? ok? :money_with_wings: 
Olivia: probably fine for Bao. if karaoke has a room charge we can split.
Sanjay: fine with $25.
Olivia: update: Bao confirmed veggie platter and can do separate prep. karaoke rooms are $10/person for 1.5 hours, paid on-site. I'll include that in the calendar note.
Jules: nice. thanks everyone. see you Friday! :party_parrot:
